description.value: The assassin makes two attacks, in any combination of Katana or Unarmed Strike.
Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage.
Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage.

If the assassin hits a creature with two or more attacks on its turn, the target must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. While affected, the creature also has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

The assassin exhales freezing wind in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 40 ([[/r 9d8]]) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, a creature is also &Reference[Restrained apply=false] by ice until the end of its next turn.

Ranged Weapon Attack: [[/attack]] to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be &Reference[Paralyzed apply=false] until the end of its next turn.

The assassin deploys a shadow lattice around one creature it can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw or be &Reference[Restrained apply=false] for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. This effect does not require &Reference[Concentration].

While in dim light or darkness, the assassin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see that is also in dim light or darkness. It has advantage on the first melee attack it makes before the end of the turn.

The assassin becomes &Reference[Invisible apply=false] for 1 minute or until it makes an attack or uses its breath weapon. While &Reference[Invisible apply=false], the ground within 5 feet of it lightly frosts, allowing it to track others while remaining unseen.

When a creature the assassin can see succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, the assassin forces that creature to reroll and use the lower result. One allied assassin the assassin can see gains advantage on its next roll.
The assassin reduces the damage of one weapon attack that would hit it by 22.
While wearing no armor and wielding no shield, the assassin’s AC includes its Wisdom modifier.
The assassin treats any d20 roll of 9 or lower on an ability check as a 10.

If the assassin is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the save, and only half damage if it fails.
The assassin ignores difficult terrain caused by ice, snow, wind, or debris. Creatures do not gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to hide from it due to weather or darkness.
The assassin deals an extra 14 ([[/r 4d6]]) cold damage when it hits a creature that is &Reference[Prone apply=false], &Reference[Restrained apply=false], or below half its hit point maximum.
